finding: Commit 2495af06 adds to the Writes row of docs/spec/interface-contracts.md § dispatch that 'the field branch_head of the ledger does not set the base, because it holds only the commit of the last merge or wave close'. DISPATCH_LEDGER in docs/spec/entity-model.md lists mode, feature_branch, branch_root, the entries, and the wave records, and names branch_head only as a field of a wave record. The code writes ledger.branch_head at init, at each merge of merge-story, and at each wave close. Add branch_head to the attributes of DISPATCH_LEDGER: the commit of the last merge or wave close on the feature branch, which sets no base. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: The contract says what the field holds and that it sets no base, so an implementer reaches the right behavior (no to fails_purpose); a reader who looks the field up in the entity model finds only the field of a wave record and must read the code to learn the ledger's own field (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the statements.
